headline: Apple posts a senior CAD role to own cross-team AMS simulation methodology
fact: Apple posted a Senior CAD Automation and Mixed-Signal Simulation Engineer role whose description assigns ownership of AMS simulation methodology across analog, RF, interconnect, PMIC, and memory teams, spanning circuit and RTL simulation, behavioral modeling, analog-digital co-simulation, logic equivalence, signoff, and automation. The posting also names wreal, real-number modeling, user-defined nets, and connect modules among the relevant methodology experience.

sources.title: Senior CAD Automation and Mixed-Signal Simulation Engineer
sources.summary: Official Apple role dated August 27, 2026, covering ownership of AMS simulation methodology, cross-team CAD automation, co-simulation and signoff flows, and wreal, RNM, UDN, and connect-module implementation.
